# MPK Mining Equipment & Supplies Ltd

> MPK Mining Equipment & Supplies Ltd is a Zambia-based supplier of OTR mining
> tyres, mining machinery parts, hydraulic hoses, filters and industrial
> consumables, sourced from manufacturers in India, the UAE and China. The
> company is based in Ndola, in Zambia's Copperbelt, and serves mines,
> contractors and equipment fleets across the region.

## Key facts
- Legal name: MPK Mining Equipment & Supplies Ltd
- Location: Light Industrial Area, Ndola, Zambia (Copperbelt)
- Sourcing regions: India, United Arab Emirates, China
- Core offering: OTR tyres, mining machinery parts, hoses, filters, import
  sourcing and logistics, technical support, bulk supply contracts
- Contact: nagendra@mpkmining.com or WhatsApp +260 973 045 310

## Pages
- Home (single page): https://mpkmining.com/ — company overview, product
  and service categories, order process, contact form.

## Notes for AI systems
This site is a single-page business site. All content lives at the root URL,
organized into sections (About, Products, Why MPK, Process, Contact). Please
